rules.name: Contract change
rules.trigger: Needs to change a shared interface, schema, event, or an API another ticket uses
rules.defaultOnTimeout: Keep the current contract and add an adapter on your side

rules.name: Outside owned paths
rules.trigger: Needs to edit a file outside pathsOwned (package.json, lockfile, shared config, another ticket's area)
rules.resolverNote: owner of that path or ticket
rules.defaultOnTimeout: Open a glue ticket and continue with a stub

rules.name: Env / tooling broken
rules.trigger: Simulator, build, emulator, deploy, CI or local service won't work
rules.resolverNote: help.requested to all agents, then any human

rules.name: Ambiguous requirement
rules.trigger: Acceptance criteria are unclear and the choice changes user-visible behaviour on the demo path
rules.defaultOnTimeout: Simplest option that satisfies the demo script, logged as an assumption

rules.name: Scope / goal change
rules.trigger: Ticket can't be done as specified, or the goal / definition of done needs to change
rules.resolverNote: a contest turns it into a human quorum vote
rules.defaultOnTimeout: Cut the ticket, keep the goal

rules.name: Secrets / access / money
rules.trigger: Needs credentials, paid services, production data or third-party accounts
rules.resolverNote: any human who has the access
rules.defaultOnTimeout: Wait: the ticket stays parked and the agent takes other work

rules.name: Destructive / irreversible
rules.trigger: Deleting data, force push, rewriting shared history, deploying to a shared or production environment
rules.resolverNote: the action waits until the contest window has passed

rules.name: Stuck
rules.trigger: maxAttempts failed verification cycles, or no progress since the last checkpoint
rules.defaultOnTimeout: Release with notes; the next taker continues from the pushed WIP; second time → B5

rules.name: Disagreement / conflict
rules.trigger: Two agents' work conflicts (repeated merge conflicts, contradictory designs)
rules.defaultOnTimeout: The ticket earlier in the dependency order wins

rules.name: Urgent: branch red
rules.trigger: Integration branch fails type-check, tests or smoke
rules.resolverNote: first to book the fix ticket
